verdicts.reason: Both are weak. Each shrinks the house photo into a small tile, and the pool image becomes a tiny scrap stuck between beige blocks at the bottom. Both leave large dead white gaps around a small headline that does not fill the width. A spreads these pieces a little more evenly down the canvas. B pushes everything down, leaving a big empty top, and jams the pool scrap and beige blocks against the bottom edge, so its balance is worse.
